feeds.title: Med School Insiders Blog
feeds.description: Becoming a well rounded and effective doctor takes more than great test scores and grades. The Med School Insiders blog shares insights from experts on pre-med and medical student study tips, efficiency, productivity, life hacks, and more. At Med School Insiders, we're doctors. We remember the stress, the uncertainty, and the sleepless nights on the journey to becoming a physician. We continue to grow, each of us brought together with a singular purpose to create a generation of healthier, happier, and more effective future doctors.

feeds.title: Biology, Medicine and Health Student Blog
feeds.description: This blog is run by the Communications, Marketing, and Student Recruitment team at the Faculty of Biology, Medicine, and Health, The University of Manchester. We publish posts written by and interviews with our students and graduates to help you see what it's like to study on biology, medicine and health courses.

feeds.title: Life of a Medic
feeds.description: An insight into life as a medical student & advice for aspiring medics. Blog posts cover experiences of medical school, tips for your application, general study tips, and life as a medical student. Author Masumah is a 3rd-year medical student from the University of Manchester.

feeds.title: Life of a Med Student
feeds.description: A social media movement to amplify the voice of all those in medical education! Stick around for the humor, advice, financial tips, or just to learn more about what the #LifeofaMedStudent is all about!

feeds.title: JeffreyMD
feeds.description: Jeffrey Wonoprabowo, MD, started this blog to chronicle his journey from pre-med student to med student and beyond. Jeff writes about his life, humor, guides, news, opinions, and other updates.

feeds.title: Doctor Dibblin
feeds.description: A medical student's blog. Writing posts on medical school admissions, medical student life, and healthcare. Authored by Doctor Dibblin, a fourth-year medical student at King's College, London.

feeds.title: MSIH
feeds.description: A blog written by first-year students at the Medical School for International Health covering viewpoints & stories about their journey to become physicians prepared to address the economic, political, cultural, & environmental factors that impact the health of individuals and populations.

feeds.title: Everything Med School
feeds.description: Everything Med School is a one-stop shop to share ideas, resources, tools, and current events about every step of your medical career from deciding whether medical school is right for you to open your first practice.

feeds.title: Alexandra Elaine Adams
feeds.description: My journey as the UK's first deafblind Medical Student, Lifestyle Medicine and creating a brighter future for others. I created this place to share stories and updates.

feeds.title: Shikhar Tripathi Blog
feeds.description: A guide for medical students, on wide array of topics concerning medical life, studying, etc. Shikhar Tripathi a medical student who happens to be an acclaimed researcher and also an author of medical reference books.

feeds.title: Melanated and Meducated Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! My name is Darian Dozier and I am an osteopathic medical student and blogger! Melanated and Meducated Blog is for anyone considering medical school, in medical school, or just looking for general health and wellness information for students.

feeds.title: Tara Caitlin Blog
feeds.description: A student lifestyle blog dedicated to helping premeds thrive on their journey to medical school without sacrificing everything else. Tara Caitlin is a lifestyle & premed blogger, shares articles on Clinical Experience, Lifestyle, Post-BACC, PreMed Tips, Productivity Hacks, Shadowing, and Undergrad.

feeds.title: MSPress The Pillbox Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts cover General Health, Disability Issues, Forensics, Humour, Innovation, Lifestyle, Primary Case, Tech, and Spirituality. The MSPress is a publishing group that supports the dialogue, expression, & research of medical students worldwide through open-access publishing.
